Did they get permission from the relatives before they exhumed her body?

A 'bog body' unearthed in Northern Ireland was a young woman who was decapitated 2,000 years ago, experts have revealed. Ancient human remains were first discovered about three feet (one metre) below the surface of government-owned in Bellaghy, a village in County Londonderry. Described as 'well preserved' but not totally intact, the bones were found with partial skin, fingernails of the left hand, toenails and even what's thought to be a kidney.

Clever beautiful creatures.

Millions of large red crabs have started their annual migration to the sea. Striking footage shows masses of crustaceans scuttling sideways across roads, over bridges and through forests on Australia's Christmas Island. The yearly march  - which takes place during 'rainy season' - sees more than 100million crabs move to the sea to breed from the remote territory on the Indian Ocean.
